hypothesis: A persistent finite crop program chosen from source training feedback can improve current-case visual evidence and downstream answers beyond equal-area/equal-count fixed quadrant zooms, while retaining every original image. H0 remains primary.
motivation: v13 changed12/12tool-observation pairs but no answers; passive text/history/review have no support. v14 proposal rejected before targets, not evidence against joint vision; do not repair or reuse it. This independent experiment changes actual visual preprocessing, not tool-query wording.

selection.training: Original24 v9B training cases and their H0_train attempts plus unadjudicated benchmark feedback; all sources retained. Only source text/feedback sent to the one program proposal, no target questions or outcomes.
selection.development: Same six v13/v14 panel cases, originally first3 v7B H0 errors and first3 correct. No selection using v13/v14 results; adaptive development with known exposed labels.
selection.separation: Source/target case IDs and known canonical image paths disjoint; not a claim of patient-independent evaluation.

policy.schema: admit,crop_ids exactly4 distinct ints0-8,source_indices4-24 unique0-23,rationale1-1600chars. At least2 crop IDs outside fixed set; canonical sorted IDs. Decline empty lists. No generated code execution.
policy.catalog: Nine half-width by half-height windows with x/y origins0,0.25,0.5; IDs row-major0-8. Fixed four corners0,2,6,8. Every crop512x512, native Pillow crop+resize.
policy.application: Same immutable4-region program to EVERY current image of every target; no target-conditioned crop policy. All original images first, then4actual crops per original image. Metadata only maps coordinates/paths/parent image; no source feedback/rationale.
policy.supervision: All24 original B source text/attempts plus unadjudicated benchmark feedback. No source/target image, target question/outcome or rejected v14 program enters generation.

execution.current_fact_prefix: No mandatory tool prefix. Deterministic current-image crop creation before controller inference. Both crop arms append4derived images per original, same crop area/2xzoom/512x512 dimensions. Originals remain unchanged first.
execution.controller: Original native author prompt/six tools/two-turn letter scoring/current questions. Additional common mapping identifies each crop as a derivative of current image, never another patient/timepoint. All original and derived current-image paths allowed to tools. H0 input unchanged.
execution.bounds: All originals+4crops per original,10or20image attachments per request. Per-case12controller/16tools/3600sec. No new tool/model weights or mandatory tool call.
execution.order: Casewise3-arm rotation; second block reverse target order and shift rotation by1; new Agent/MemorySaver every physical episode, no aliases.
execution.scoring: Read gold only after all predictions or termination; full planned denominators, exact final A-F.
execution.model: Existing local subscription gpt-6.1-sol/high; all medical tools/weights unchanged; no new credentials,API provider or paid resource.

gate.requirements: All36 valid and admitted program. BOTH repeats learned vsH0 net>=2/6 with H0loss<=1; learned vsfixed net>=1/6; >=2 cases repeated H0 wrong/learned correct with actual resized crop pixels differing from fixed in each repeat.
gate.interpretation: Actual pixel-difference test is a scientific intervention check, not transfer-integrity validation or proof of medically useful evidence. Exploratory outcome-enriched reused benchmark only.
gate.fail: Close fixed policy/variant; no proposal regeneration, target/source resampling, prompt/threshold changes or selective reruns inside experiment.
gate.statistics: All paired effects/descriptive McNemar; real crop geometry/pixel-difference/count and input-image/token/tool/time/rate/failure costs. No patient-independent or clinical endpoint claim; repeated cases do not increase N.

limitations: Source feedback not medically adjudicated; no expert O or Pro E1.
Six reused outcome-enriched cases and one global source-only crop program; adaptive development, not patient-independent confirmation.
512x512 crops standardize count/area/size; image content/token cost not exactly equal. H0 has fewer image attachments.
Original clinical images retained, crop images contain no new clinical facts and can degrade context or magnify artifacts.
Tool access includes only current originals and their derivatives; no source images or96confirmation images.
This is a source-learned external perception program, not parameter training or complete A-to-B HCL retention.
